rules.message: Page titles go through PageHeader — never a bare <h1> in a page body (PLACEMENT.md, Header slots).
Use the DS table primitives, not a raw <table> (ADOPTION.md gate 2).
Use the Button primitive, not a bare <button> (ADOPTION.md gate 2).
Use semantic tokens (bg-muted, text-muted-foreground, Badge variant), not a literal Tailwind palette class (audit-signals: literal-color).
Use focus-visible:ring-2 ring-ring (audit-signals: weak-focus-ring).
Use the shadcn atom — Input / Select / Textarea (audit-signals: raw-html-control).

A prop named from the appearance-noun list is a per-call-site appearance the contract does not derive (RULES.md hard rule 12). Closed archetypes (detail-overview, form-page, list-with-detail, settings-table) are gated by their own `*-` error rules. Excluded: entity-circle — its `tone` is contract-keyed to the entity's identity role (entity-circle.md L7: brand tone reserved for the signed-in identity; every other entity is neutral), so ADR-0004's derived test passes and the prop is legal.

A prop typed as an inline string-literal union of look-names is a design space two projects can fill differently (RULES.md hard rule 12). Closed archetypes (detail-overview, form-page, list-with-detail, crud-dialog, settings-table) are gated by their own `*-` error rules.

`className` is an unenumerable superset escape hatch on a shell's outer wrapper — fork the component instead (RULES.md hard rule 12). Scoped to top-level props (indent ≤2) so a nested leaf descriptor (the matrix-grid per-cell `cellStyle` field — styling data, not shell appearance) is not flagged. The `include` is an array so it catches both the `*Shell.tsx`-named page shells and the `*Sheet.tsx`-named overlay shells (e.g. crud-dialog's `CrudDialogSheet`) — a shell not named `*Shell.tsx` would otherwise slip the gate.

An appearance-bearing `ReactNode` slot (`header`, `stats`) is a per-call-site appearance prop by another name (RULES.md hard rule 12). Closed archetypes (detail-overview, form-page, list-with-detail, settings-table) are gated by their own `*-` error rules.

detail-overview's `surface` axis is deleted — `unified` is the only container model (archetype-convergence detail-overview close-API). Re-adding it reopens the inherited-default defect (RULES.md hard rule 12).
detail-overview's `rhythm` prop is deleted — the contract sets no 'short' threshold, so nobody derives the same value (RULES.md hard rule 12).
`className` is an unenumerable superset escape hatch on the detail-overview shell — `className="border-0 shadow-none"` reconstitutes the deleted `surface="separated"` (RULES.md hard rule 12).
detail-overview's `header` / `stats` are typed data (`title`/`subtitle`/`badges`/`actions`, `stats: StatItem[]`), not appearance-bearing `ReactNode` slots (RULES.md hard rule 12).

detail-overview accepts no `headerFill` override — it is a closed project context set once at `<AppShell>`; an override next to it is the escape-hatch defect this roadmap removes (RULES.md hard rule 12).

`className` is an unenumerable superset escape hatch on the form-page shell (RULES.md hard rule 12). form-page is closed: `width` is contract-keyed to field count / column layout and the shell carries no `className` prop — fork the component instead.

list-with-detail's `detailPresentation` axis is deleted — the mobile overlay (Sheet) is always on (responsive structure, not a page choice) and the discretionary desktop-overlay mode had no data-derived key (archetype-convergence list-with-detail close-API). Re-adding it reopens the inherited-default defect (RULES.md hard rule 12).

list-with-detail's `unstyled` flush flag is deleted — the chrome-suppression decision belongs to the *composing* archetype via the internal `ListChromeContext` (mirroring detail-overview's `UnifiedSurfaceContext`), not to a per-page prop (RULES.md hard rule 12).
`className` is an unenumerable superset escape hatch on the list-with-detail shell — fork the component instead (archetype-convergence list-with-detail close-API; RULES.md hard rule 12).

`className` is an unenumerable superset escape hatch on the crud-dialog shell — the CRUD-dialog shell (`CrudDialogSheet`) is the archetype's outer wrapper and is not named `*Shell.tsx`, so the generic `*Shell`-scope alone never reaches it (archetype-convergence crud-dialog close-API; RULES.md hard rule 12). Scoped to indent ≤2 top-level props, folder-wide, so re-adding `className` to the sheet or body/header/footer reopens the deleted axis.
